name: Husked Palm
description: Strike with a palm drained to a husk so the touch empties the muscle it meets.

name: Gnawing Ward
description: Bind both forearms in a gnawing grey ward that eats the edge of a weapon.

name: Fadeaway Stride
description: Stride out of a blow's path with the body pale and nearly lost to the eye.

name: Twin Cessation
description: Stop the strength of the foe's two arms one after the other with two quick touches.

name: Linked Draining
description: Link a drain to each of two foes and pull them both toward exhaustion at once.

name: Twofold Lapse
description: Let the roots of an ally's poison and its after-sickness both lapse into nothing.

name: Mirrored Decay
description: Strike one point and let the rot echo into a second point on the same body.

name: Shared Quiet
description: Share a deep quiet with an ally and let a clinging curse run out into the user's calm.

name: Perish Pair
description: Loose two overlapping waves of perishing qi that strip the vitality of all within the field.

name: Pallid Palm
description: Strike with a palm that lays a pale weight upon the chest like a shroud settling.

name: Veiled Bulwark
description: Draw a veil of grey qi before the body that thins each blow into nothing.

name: Wan Drift
description: Drift pale and slow past the edge of a swing so it seems to miss by itself.

name: Wilting Gaze
description: Fix the foe with a gaze that dims his eyes and sets the room swaying.

name: Settling Pall
description: Let the pall settle on a foe's shoulders until his arms feel too heavy to lift.

name: Shroud Rend
description: Tear through a guard with a thrust sheathed in the grey veil and hollow the flesh behind it.

name: Veil Lifting
description: Lift the pale veil of a wasting illness off an ally's face and chest.

name: Smothering Pall
description: Cast the pall wide so that every foe beneath it struggles for breath and strength.

name: Pallor Mending
description: Draw the deadly pallor out of an ally's skin and the cause out of the blood beneath.

name: Terminal Pall
description: Draw down a vast pale pall on the opposing side that saps the strength of every body under it.

name: Parallel Wither
description: Strike with one palm while the other palm withers the same point a heartbeat later.

name: Ashgrey Cover
description: Sweep a cover of ashgrey qi across the front and send a stabbing blow wide.

name: Doubled Fade
description: Fade from sight on one track and appear on another a pace along.

name: Sluggish Mark
description: Mark the foe's shoulder so the arm moves slower for the next several swings.

name: Dim Thrust
description: Thrust two fingers into a gap in the guard and dim the strength of that side.

name: Withering Track
description: Run a withering track along a foe's arm from wrist to shoulder with a drawn palm.

name: Easing Track
description: Run a soothing track down an ally's arm and lead a creeping poison out of the fingertips.

name: Entropy Lock
description: Lock a foe's limbs in a rapidly ageing grip that stiffens joints and slows movement.

name: Cessation Stream
description: Pour a steady stream of ending qi through a foe's guard and keep it running until the strength is gone.

name: Release Stream
description: Pour a gentle stream through an ally that washes a lasting backlash from the meridians.

name: Doom Knell
description: Ring one low toll of ending through a single foe's whole body so every function falters together.

name: Ebbtide Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a drawing pull like water running out of a basin.

name: Reservoir Guard
description: Hold the stored qi close under the skin and let it swallow a heavy strike.

name: Slow Pour
description: Pour the body forward in one slow unbroken glide that closes the gap before it is noticed.

name: Drain Spill
description: Spill a measure of stored ending qi into a struck foe and slow every part of him.

name: Held Overflow
description: Let the stored qi seep outward in a thin even film that wears at all who stand close.

name: Stilled Draught
description: Give an ally a measured draught of stilled qi that quiets a poison and ends its spread.

name: Slow Flood
description: Let the held qi flood out in a slow grey tide that numbs and weakens all it reaches.

name: Calm Waters
description: Spread a stilled calm over an ally that draws out a deep curse and a wasting taint.

name: Total Overflow
description: Open the whole store at once in a surge of ending qi that strips every living thing nearby.

name: Blueash Palm
description: Strike with a palm furred in blue-grey ash that numbs and chills the flesh beneath.

name: Ashfall Screen
description: Let a screen of falling ash gather before the body and soften a heavy blow.

name: Blue Fade
description: Vanish into a drift of blue ash and come out a half-pace to the side.

name: Cinderblind
description: Throw a pinch of cold ash into the foe's eyes so the world dims and swims.

name: Cinder Flick
description: Flick a spark of cold ash at an exposed wrist so the nerve there goes dead.

name: Ash Shroud
description: Wear a shroud of ash qi that dulls blows and wearies those who strike it.

name: Smouldering Chill
description: Drive a smouldering chill into the core of a foe's body and spread it outward.

name: Ash Consolation
description: Brush an ally with cold ash that lifts a clinging fever-poison and fades with it.

name: Ash Storm Veil
description: Whirl a veil of blue ash about the foes so that sight and sense of place both fail.

name: Falling Ruin
description: Let a heavy fall of ash drop from the qi field and wear at the flesh of all beneath.

name: Ash Absolution
description: Rain a cold gentle ash on allies that burns away a binding curse and leaves no mark.

name: Sapphire Cessation
description: Let the whole field fall to blue-grey ash and still the strength of every foe within it.

name: Broad Wither
description: Strike with the flat of both hands so the wither spreads wide across the chest.

name: Level Wane
description: Square the shoulders and let a blow meet a broad level wall of waning qi.

name: Loose Stride
description: Cover ground in long loose strides that leave the foe's swings a step behind.

name: Sallow Touch
description: Touch the foe's cheek and leave a sallow patch that tells of failing health.

name: Slow Blight
description: Spread a slow blight over the ground and up the legs of all who tread it.

name: Gaunt Sweep
description: Sweep a broad arm across a foe's body and leave the flesh gaunt and weak.

name: Blight Remedy
description: Draw a spreading blight out of an ally's legs and let it fade into the open ground.

name: Level Ruin
description: Spread ruin across a broad front so that everything living within it sags.

name: Fallow Rest
description: Lay allies down to a fallow rest that lets deep taint and ill effects wither away.

name: Barren Verdict
description: Pass a verdict of barrenness over the whole stretch of ground and strip the life from all that stands on it.

name: Oathborne Palm
description: Strike with a palm sworn to be clean and swift and leave no needless pain.

name: Ashen Vow Guard
description: Hold a forearm guard bound by oath to give no ground to a striker.

name: Pledged Fade
description: Stride forward a pledged pace and hold the line against any pushing aside.

name: Binding Hush
description: Whisper an oath over the foe's hands and leave them bound by the weight of it.

name: Breath Gauge
description: Gauge the breath and pulse of a near person to judge how much strength is left.

name: Sworn Cessation
description: Keep the oath of a clean ending and stop the strength of the foe's striking arm in one touch.

name: Oath Lapse
description: Speak the words that undo a curse of binding laid on an ally and let it fall.

name: Oathburden
description: Lay the weight of a sworn ending on a foe until every limb drags.

name: Clean Ending
description: Thrust a single clean line of ending qi through the guard and into the vital core beyond.

name: Vowed Lapse
description: Release an ally from a poison or taint by a vow that the sickness shall end here.

name: Oath of Closure
description: Close the oath over one foe and take away vitality that no guard or armour can turn.

name: Carried Wither
description: Loose a thin gust of withering qi that carries to a foe a few paces away.

name: Lee Guard
description: Turn the back to the wind and let blows glance off a screen of dying air.

name: Slackened Gust
description: Move on the lull of a gust so the step cannot be heard or seen.

name: Gusted Wane
description: Send waning qi before a gust so foes upwind find their strength draining away.

name: Spent Squall
description: Loose a squall of spent air across a small group and sap the heat from them.

name: Backwind Cure
description: Draw sickness back from an ally on a returning wind and let it blow itself out.

name: Withering Front
description: March a front of withering air across the field and leave a grey stillness behind it.

name: Wane Draught
description: Pull a cool draft through allies that sweeps out a poison and calms a feverish backlash.

name: Deathly Calm
description: Still the air itself so that all within lose strength and the breath comes with great effort.

name: Dirge Palm
description: Strike in time to a low chant so the blow lands with a deadening hum.

name: Mourning Guard
description: Bow into a heavy guard that takes a blow like a mourner takes grief.

name: Measured Pace
description: Walk in a slow measured pace that the foe cannot time or hurry.

name: Hummed Lull
description: Hum a low drone that wearies the foe's mind and softens his guard.

name: Lament Reading
description: Hum a note and listen to how the life of those near answers.

name: Toll Strike
description: Strike a toll upon the body that rings through and numbs the whole frame.

name: Slow Elegy
description: Sing a slow elegy that drags on the strength and the pulse of each foe who hears.

name: Gentle Requiem
description: Sing a gentle requiem over an ally that settles a poison and lets it pass out.

name: Bearing Toll
description: Ring a toll on the foe's life and hold his limbs fast in the sound.

name: Fell Knell
description: Ring a hard knell through one body that breaks the rhythm of the heart.

name: Dirge Balm
description: Chant a balm over wounded allies that takes the sting of a curse out of them.

name: Hymn of Rest
description: Chant a hymn of rest that dissolves a wasting weakness left by a harsh breakthrough.

name: Great Dirge
description: Raise a great dirge across the field that numbs the strength of everyone who hears it.

name: Entropic Palm
description: Strike with a palm that hastens the wear in the struck gear and flesh.

name: Bounded Ward
description: Draw a ward that ages whatever crosses its edge and spares whatever is within.

name: Pointed Fade
description: Fade along a line the user alone chooses and reappear precisely where aimed.

name: Aimed Rot
description: Send a bead of rot at one named target and spare everything else near it.

name: Chosen Decay
description: Direct a heavy decay into a single chosen part of a foe's body.

name: Pointed Wane
description: Let waning qi run only along the line to one foe and leave allies beside him untouched.

name: Entropic Mending
description: Turn the ending qi inward to eat a poison inside an ally while sparing the body around it.

name: Careful Collapse
description: Collapse the structure of everything in a marked ring while leaving a chosen few unharmed.

name: Selective Release
description: Pick one curse out of an ally's body and bring only that one to its end.

name: Pointed Ruin
description: Point the whole weight of entropy at a single target and unmake its strength in an instant.
